Package hadur117.core.melee

Class TeamDodge

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.TeamDodge
final class TeamDodge extends Object
TMODE-27, Ogi's dodge as one piece: the team movement that replaces the virtual bullets of MMOVE-3 and every switch laid on them (SOFT, LEARN, POOL, WAVES) while it plays.
  1. Who it was for. A detected shot counts for Hadur by 1/(1+k)^2 for the k teammates nearer its source (TMODE-2), or by MMOVE-9's nearest rule where the table says the team shoots its closest enemy (TMODE-20).
  2. Where it went. When a shot is first seen it is turned once into a profile: each of AimExperts' simple aims at Hadur's state when it was fired, and the team's learned aims pooled by class, each carrying its expert's weight against that enemy class. Profiles are made once a shot, never per candidate, which is what kept the learned aims (LEARN with WAVES) from costing skipped turns.
  3. Where to go. The base risk ranks the candidates without any bullet in it (RANK_BULLETS off), the RERANK safest and the held destination are each driven to for 30 ticks through every profile and, for 15, through the teammates' bullets (TMODE-25), and the score is Ogi's risk/median + 3 x damage/median.

Team-only, like every mode: the controller reaches it only with a living teammate.

    • OWN_FIRE

      static final boolean OWN_FIRE
      TMODE-29, on since TMODE-30 (ablation tmnoof turns it off): our own fire as PATH weighs it. The base ranking keeps MATEFIRE's teammate-bullet risk, and the teammates' bullets crossed on each drive add to the risk at MinimumRiskMovement.PATH_K rather than to the median-scaled damage.
